case_title: State vs. Rakesh Sharma — Armed Robbery

transcript.text: Trial 'State vs. Rakesh Sharma — Armed Robbery' opened by Justice Mehta.
Justice Mehta (Presiding Judge) joined the court.
Adv. Priya Sharma (Defence Counsel) joined the court.
Adv. Suresh Rao (Prosecution Counsel) joined the court.
Ramu the Witness (Witness 1) joined the court.
Order in the court. This trial is now in session. Prosecution may present the opening statement.

Your Honour, the State alleges that on the night of March 15, the accused Rakesh Sharma committed armed robbery at the State Bank of India, Ashok Nagar branch, threatening the cashier with a firearm and fleeing with Rs. 24 lakhs.
My client pleads not guilty. The evidence is circumstantial and relies on a single eyewitness identification under poor lighting conditions.
Proceedings moved to the Examination phase.
Objection sustained. Rephrase the question, Prosecution.
Justice Mehta (Presiding Judge) left the court.
Ramu the Witness (Witness) left the court.
Adv. Priya Sharma (Defence Counsel) left the court.
Adv. Suresh Rao (Prosecution Counsel) left the court.
